title: Lakeside Picnic, 1949 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white snapshot capturing a family or group enjoying a summer lakeside picnic on July 31, 1949. A shirtless young man in swim trunks leans over a wooden picnic table filled with glass soda or beer bottles, food containers, and a tablecloth. A woman sits nearby looking toward the water. In the background, a serene lake with forested shores reflects the mid-century American lifestyle of outdoor recreational leisure following World War II.
